'''''Utricularia subulata''''', the '''zigzag bladderwort''',<ref name="PLANTS">{{PLANTS|taxon=Utricularia subulata|symbol=UTSU|access-date=2008-12-28}}</ref> is a small [[annual plant|annual]], terrestrial [[carnivorous plant]] that belongs to the [[genus]] ''[[Utricularia]]'' (family [[Lentibulariaceae]]). It is the most widely distributed species in the genus, being almost [[pantropical]].<ref name="Taylor 1989">Taylor, Peter. (1989). ''[[The genus Utricularia - a taxonomic monograph]]''. Kew Bulletin Additional Series XIV: London.</ref>

It is native to the Americas, Africa, and Australia<ref>{{cite POWO | id = 260854-2 | title = Utricularia subulata}}</ref>
